answer: Sequential elapsed-time attestation. Each identity must complete a genuine multi-week voyage of scheduled, randomized check-ins whose timestamps are chained and cross-logged by unrelated peers. An account's weight in matching and payouts scales with uninterrupted verified uptime, not balance. The mirror of this rule: any gap or backdated entry voids accrued weight, forcing restart. Attackers pay real calendar time per identity, and running many identities in parallel multiplies that delay, since each needs its own continuous schedule.
